Match.Player.SpeedTip: Speed: a step a second, ×2 or ×4 (+ / −)
Match.Player.Help:
Keys:
Space — pause / play
← → — event
Ctrl+← → — turn
Enter, Backspace — step
+ − — speed
Esc — back to History
Match.Player.Truncated: The replay is incomplete: the game went over the recording limit.
Match.Player.BgOldFile: Step-by-step replays exist for games played after the update; this one has rounds and the lobby.
Match.Timeline.LegendConstructed: Timeline: segments are turns (yours have a bar on top, M is the mulligan), ticks are events. Click or drag to go there.
Match.Timeline.LegendBattlegrounds: Timeline: numbered segments are the tavern, crossed swords are combats (green won, red lost), ticks are events. Click or drag to go there.
